note: Hardcoded from real Google reviews (captured 2026-09-01). 'date' is the review's actual post date (ISO) — the 'when' label is computed from it at render time so it stays accurate. Where 'date' is unknown, 'when' is a literal string. Homepage shows the first 3; /reviews shows all. Keep the 3 independent customers first. Switch to the live Featurable feed once Business Profile access is sorted (set featurableWidgetId in site.json); this file then reverts to offline fallback only.

reviews.name: Melanie Voelker
reviews.text: We are so pleased with how our carpets turned out. Augie was on time, professional, and thorough about explaining the process and what to expect. Our two kids kept getting in the way and he was great with them, even explaining what he was doing when they asked their lots and lots of questions. Our carpet has never felt so clean, and it looks impeccable.

reviews.name: Maria Jacquet
reviews.text: I was ready to either pull out my hair or my carpet before I found this company. I took a chance and called Mr. Yanta, and he was very personable and understanding of my sad carpet situation, embarrassing as it was. My carpets look amazing. Thank you for your professionalism!

reviews.name: Emmet O'Connell
reviews.text: Augie was excellent, did great work, and was very knowledgeable.

reviews.name: Isaac Yanta
reviews.text: Exceptional is definitely the word. My wife and I have five animals, including some puppies, so our house was more than a little stinky. After Augie and Fresh Fibers came by, it was like we just moved in again. They showed up on time, had the most competitive pricing in town, and even checked in a couple of days later to make sure we were satisfied with the job.

reviews.name: Dominic Cummings
reviews.text: Augie came over and cleaned our two bedrooms, hallway, living room, sunroom, and bathroom tile. Excellent is an understatement. He was extremely friendly and easy to work with on setting up a time and date.
